lineItems.itemDescription:
1. Statutory fee set by Government and collected by Rushcliffe Borough Council, currently £274.00. A Certificate of Lawfulness for a Proposed Use or Operation is charged at one half of the equivalent £548.00 householder application fee.
2. THIS FEE IS NOT CHARGED BY NOBLE ARCHITECTURE AND IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE TOTAL BELOW. It is shown here for completeness only, which is why it carries a nil value.
3. You will pay Rushcliffe Borough Council directly. Noble Architecture will obtain the full payment details, the correct reference and the accepted method of payment on your behalf, and will pass them to you before the application is submitted.
4. The application cannot be lodged with the council until this fee has cleared.
